purpose: Track Cerebras CS-4 and WSE-3 Turbo as a rack-scale wafer-scale inference platform for frontier and disaggregated LLM inference.

llm_relevance: Extremely high on-wafer SRAM bandwidth targets low-latency autoregressive inference.
Direct Wafer Links reduce wafer-to-wafer latency and support very large model partitions across racks.
Cerebras explicitly supports heterogeneous disaggregated inference, including external prefill engines handing off to CS-4 decode.
hardware.availability_note: Cerebras states first CS-4 shipments begin in Q3 2026.

benchmark_evidence.note: Cerebras reports more than 4,400 TPS/user with identical prompts in its comparison and claims up to 30x faster inference than compared GPU systems. Treat as manufacturer evidence until independently reproduced.
Manufacturer claim comparing CS-4 with previous-generation CS-3, not an independent cross-vendor tokens-per-watt result.

open_questions: system and rack power at idle, prefill and decode
throughput at realistic concurrency and context lengths
external memory hierarchy and model-weight residency behavior
heterogeneous prefill-to-decode handoff performance with AMD/AWS partner systems
